name: Ranger Masterful Archery: stacks only while in Elude and the next Precision Shot consumes them (#1318)
contract: Masterful Archery 680469 reads 'While in Elude, gain a stack of Masterful Archery every $T1 sec.' and its buff 680471 reads 'Your next Precision Shot now deals $s2% increased damage for $d, stacking up to $u times.' 680469 is a permanent passive whose only effect is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, amplitude 2000, on 573450, which triggers 680471 on the caster; nothing in Spell.dbc ties the tick to Elude (801345, the Ranger's stealth form, aura 16 + shapeshift 30), so stacks accrued every 2 sec in and out of Elude. 680471 is a 10 sec (DurationIndex 1) self aura, StackAmount 5, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE +10% on EffectSpellClassMask (0,8388608,0) = Precision Shot, with Spell.dbc ProcCharges 0, so no Precision Shot ever used it up. Expected: no stacks while out of Elude; at least two stacks within 6 sec in Elude; none added after leaving Elude; the buff carries one charge; the next Precision Shot that lands removes a fresh 10 sec buff about 3.6 sec in. Before the fix the first assertion already sees stacks outside Elude.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Masterful Archery is active on the Ranger
Outside Elude no Masterful Archery stack is gained
SETUP: the Ranger is in Elude
In Elude a stack is gained every 2 sec
Masterful Archery is spent by one Precision Shot: it carries a single charge
Two tick periods after leaving Elude
No stack is gained after leaving Elude
A fresh 10 sec buff with three stacks
The Precision Shot consumed Masterful Archery
